C0534.title: Taobao Says Paying to Delete Negative Reviews Will Lead to Immediate Store Closure
C0534.summary: In November 2012, media reported that police in Chongqing High-tech Zone uncovered a fraud case involving an illegal website that offered to delete negative reviews for Taobao sellers. Scammers falsely claimed they could remove bad reviews through technical means. Taobao stated that any online store found maliciously deleting negative reviews would be shut down immediately.
